title: Parts Vendors list page shows Vendor and State/Province filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Vendors list page.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the vendors table.
expected: 1. The Vendors page shows two filter buttons: Vendor and State/Province.
2. The table shows the columns: Name, Telephone, Email, Address 1, Address 2, City, State/Province and Zip/Postal Code.
3. A blue New Vendor button is shown at the top right.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #8
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Frame is named 'Vendor Invoices' in Figma but shows the Vendors list (design typo, §C.4). Option lists pending Branko's PRD. CONFLICT - PENDING DESIGN (Questions Q6 / deltas C7): engineering found NO Figma frame for the Parts Vendors view (they read frame 11903:10461 as Vendor Invoices, not a Vendors typo) and will NOT build Vendors filters until a design is delivered. This case's chip set may change - hold against the requested design + PRD.
